edges.reason: msg.sender becomes the from address of transfer.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is reduced in transferFrom.
msg.sender flows into _transfer as the sender address.
msg.sender is passed as owner argument to _approve.
manualswap requires _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend requires _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1.
renounceOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
openTrading is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
setBots is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
delBot is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
setCooldownEnabled is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
constructor stores _msgSender() as the privileged _owner.
cooldown[to] is read and written using block.timestamp (timestamp dependency).
block.timestamp gates the cooldown require checks inside _transfer.
block.timestamp is supplied as the swap deadline.
block.timestamp is supplied as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
from parameter is used for zero-address and pair checks in _transfer.
to parameter indexes cooldown, bots and fee exclusion in _transfer.
amount parameter is validated against _maxTxAmount in _transfer.
sender parameter reduces reflection balance in _transferStandard.
recipient parameter increases reflection balance in _transferStandard.
tAmount parameter seeds the fee/reflection math.
amount parameter is halved and transferred in sendETHToFee.
bots_ array entries are written into the bots blacklist.
notbot parameter clears the blacklist entry.
spender parameter is forwarded from approve to _approve.
contractTokenBalance local drives swapTokensForEth inside _transfer.
contractETHBalance local gates the sendETHToFee call inside _transfer.
path local array is passed to the router swap call.
tokenAmount parameter is approved and swapped in swapTokensForEth.
_transfer delegates the actual movement to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard.
_transferStandard obtains amounts from _getValues.
_transferStandard takes the team fee via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard reflects the fee via _reflectFee.
_getValues reads the current rate.
_getRate derives supply values from _getCurrentSupply.
_transfer performs the external swap (swapTokensForEth) before sender/recipient balances are settled.
_transfer sends ETH out to fee wallets before the transfer accounting completes.
swapTokensForEth reaches the external router swap call.
sendETHToFee reaches external ETH value transfers.
openTrading reaches the external addLiquidityETH call.
The router swap calls back into the token transfer logic, re-entering _transfer before state is final.
Value transfer to fee wallets is an external call reachable while inSwap accounting is incomplete.
addLiquidityETH invokes transferFrom on the token, re-entering token transfer logic.
transfer forwards to the internal _transfer.
transferFrom forwards to the internal _transfer.
transferFrom reduces allowance via _approve with SafeMath.sub.
approve delegates to _approve.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal.
_takeTeam increases the contract entry of _rOwned.
_transferStandard updates sender and recipient _rOwned balances.
_transfer writes cooldown[to] using block.timestamp.
_transfer reads/writes the inSwap reentrancy guard.
_transfer calls balanceOf(address(this)).
balanceOf converts reflection balance via tokenFromReflection.
tokenFromReflection reads the current rate.
swapTokensForEth approves the router before swapping.
sendETHToFee transfers ETH to _feeAddrWallet1.
sendETHToFee transfers ETH to _feeAddrWallet2.
openTrading assigns the router state variable.
openTrading assigns the created pair address.
openTrading enables swapEnabled.
openTrading enables cooldownEnabled.
openTrading sets _maxTxAmount.
openTrading sets tradingOpen.
openTrading uses owner() as the liquidity recipient.
openTrading reads balanceOf(address(this)) for liquidity.
swapTokensForEth calls the router state variable.
setBots writes the bots blacklist mapping.
delBot writes the bots blacklist mapping.
setCooldownEnabled writes cooldownEnabled.
renounceOwnership clears the _owner state variable.
constructor initializes _owner through Ownable.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee.
_transfer compares from/to against uniswapV2Pair.
_transfer checks the bots blacklist for from and to.
_transfer checks _isExcludedFromFee for from and to.
_transfer enforces the _maxTxAmount buy limit.
_transfer reads owner() to bypass fee logic for the owner.

normalization_plan.reason: from is a parameter of _transfer used only for checks and balance updates.
to is a parameter of _transfer used only for checks, cooldown and balance updates.
amount is a parameter of _transfer used for the max-transaction limit check.
sender is a parameter of _transferStandard used to decrement reflection balance.
recipient is a parameter of _transferStandard used to increment reflection balance.
tAmount is a parameter of _transferStandard feeding the fee/reflection math.
amount is the parameter of sendETHToFee split between the two fee wallets.
bots_ is the parameter of setBots written into the blacklist mapping.
notbot is the parameter of delBot clearing the blacklist entry.
spender is the parameter of approve forwarded to _approve.
This local is computed inside _transfer only to be passed to swapTokensForEth.
This local is computed inside _transfer only to be passed to sendETHToFee.
path is a swap-routing local used solely by the router swap call.
tokenAmount is the parameter of swapTokensForEth approved and swapped.
